kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
wire.summary: Senegal's breakdancers have been practicing for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games this month. It's the first time Africa is hosting an Olympic event.

wire.title: Kennedy relatives join the fight against Trump's arch, alleging harm to JFK's grave
wire.summary: Nine members of the Kennedy family have joined the legal fight against Trump's D.C. arch, arguing it would disrupt views and cast shadows over their ancestors' graves at Arlington National Cemetery.

wire.title: What's behind democratic socialists' historic victories in the midterms?
wire.summary: Historian and The New Yorker writer Jill Lepore says the DSA, once maligned, is no longer "beyond the political pale." She discusses the history of socialism in America, and its current resurgence.

wire.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
wire.summary: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

wire.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a prisoner exchange as talks end with no big breakthrough
wire.summary: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war. U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led to this decision, marking the biggest humanitarian release since the war began in 2022.

wire.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
wire.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.

wire.title: An Iran-backed trio is accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
wire.summary: Iran-backed operatives have been charged over nearly 20 attacks, including a plot on a U.K. base housing U.S. troops. Separately, a U.S. soldier is held in the U.K. on Russia spying claims.

wire.title: Morning News Brief: Hegseth impeachment, new House GOP leader, UK probes base plot
wire.summary: Republicans block Hegseth impeachment, Trump ally picked to lead House GOP minority, UK investigates alleged Iran-backed plot.

wire.title: Independent Rep. Kevin Kiley says voters want 'checks and balances' in government
wire.summary: Rep. Kevin Kiley, a former Republican turned independent, lost his reelection bid. He discusses what went wrong for the GOP, the challenges of the two-party system and how Congress could work better.

wire.title: Both sides now? Critics slam DOJ moves to dismiss convictions of Trump allies
wire.summary: The DOJ moved to dismiss criminal convictions of former Trump adviser Steve Bannon and of the Oath Keepers, in what it calls "the interests of justice." Critics are crying foul.

wire.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
wire.summary: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

wire.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
wire.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

wire.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
wire.summary: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

wire.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
wire.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.

wire.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
wire.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

wire.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
wire.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.
